sectors.name: Technology
sectors.summary: Global software, cloud, platform, and hardware leaders tied to enterprise spending and productivity cycles.
sectors.description: Technology sector encompasses software platforms, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, semiconductor equipment, and consumer electronics. Driven by digital transformation spending, artificial intelligence adoption, and consumer demand cycles.

sectors.name: Banking
sectors.summary: Global banks, brokers, and payment rails driven by rates, credit quality, capital markets, and regulation.
sectors.description: Banking sector includes commercial banks, investment banks, insurance companies, and payment processors. Sensitive to interest rate cycles, credit quality, and economic growth. Benefits from higher rates and wider net interest margins.
sectors.investorProfile: Value investors, dividend seekers, interest rate traders

sectors.name: AI
sectors.summary: A cross-sector theme spanning accelerators, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, cybersecurity, and automation.
sectors.description: Artificial Intelligence is a cross-sector theme impacting technology, healthcare, finance, manufacturing, and logistics. Includes GPU makers, cloud platforms, data analytics, robotics, and autonomous systems. Fastest-growing secular trend globally.
sectors.investorProfile: Growth investors, early-stage tech believers, momentum traders

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.summary: Oil, gas, refiners, LNG, and power assets linked to crude prices, OPEC policy, and energy security.
sectors.description: Energy sector includes upstream oil & gas producers, refining, LNG, power generation, and utilities. Driven by commodity prices, geopolitical supply risk, energy demand cycles, and energy transition capex.
sectors.investorProfile: Income seekers, commodity traders, infrastructure investors

sectors.name: Healthcare
sectors.summary: Pharma, biotech, medical devices, and insurers with defensive cash flows and innovation cycles.
sectors.description: Healthcare sector includes pharmaceutical companies, biotech innovators, medical device makers, diagnostics, and healthcare insurers. Benefits from aging demographics, chronic disease prevalence, and innovation cycles. Defensive, non-cyclical sector.
sectors.investorProfile: Defensive investors, dividend seekers, aging-population believers

sectors.name: Mining
sectors.summary: Producers of iron ore, copper, lithium, gold, and platinum tied to China demand and energy transition capex.
sectors.description: Mining sector includes precious metals, base metals, and rare earth producers. Driven by commodity cycles, China growth, energy transition demand (lithium, copper), and inflation hedging characteristics.
sectors.investorProfile: Commodity traders, energy transition believers, inflation hedgers

sectors.name: Semiconductor
sectors.summary: Chip designers, foundries, equipment makers, and memory leaders powering AI, autos, smartphones, and data centers.
sectors.description: Semiconductor industry spans chip design (fabless), foundries (TSMC, Samsung), equipment makers (ASML), and memory. Critical infrastructure for AI, EVs, smartphones, and data centers. Driven by geopolitical competition and supply chain resilience.
sectors.investorProfile: Growth investors, geopolitical strategists, long-term AI believers

sectors.name: Real Estate
sectors.summary: REITs, developers, data centers, logistics, and commercial property sensitive to rates and credit availability.
sectors.description: Real Estate Investment Trusts (REITs) and property developers. Includes residential, commercial, data centers, logistics hubs. Sensitive to interest rates, credit availability, urbanization, and e-commerce trends.
sectors.investorProfile: Income investors, rate watchers, infrastructure believers

sectors.name: Electric Vehicles
sectors.summary: EV manufacturers, battery makers, charging networks, and raw material suppliers powering the global transition from fossil fuels.
sectors.description: Electric vehicle ecosystem includes car manufacturers (Tesla, BYD, NIO), battery makers (CATL, LG Energy), charging infrastructure, and critical materials suppliers. Fastest-growing segment of automotive. Government subsidies and climate mandates drive growth.
sectors.investorProfile: Growth investors, ESG believers, long-term energy transition bettors

sectors.name: Defence
sectors.summary: Defence and aerospace contractors supplying military equipment, missiles, and intelligence systems. Driven by geopolitics and government spending.
sectors.description: Defence sector includes aerospace & defense contractors, military equipment suppliers, and intelligence/surveillance systems. Driven by geopolitical tensions, military modernization spending, and government budgets. Relative growth opportunity.
sectors.investorProfile: Geopolitical strategists, defence investors, government spending believers

sectors.name: Retail
sectors.summary: E-commerce platforms, department stores, apparel, and discount retailers sensitive to consumer spending and discretionary income.
sectors.description: Retail sector encompasses e-commerce platforms, brick-and-mortar retailers, discount chains, and specialty retail. Sensitive to consumer confidence, unemployment, discretionary income, and e-commerce penetration trends.
sectors.investorProfile: Consumer cycle traders, e-commerce believers, value investors
